notifications_subject_check.name: notifications_subject_check
notifications_subject_check.value: ("notifications"."kind" = 'follow' AND "notifications"."post_id" IS NULL) OR ("notifications"."kind" <> 'follow' AND "notifications"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)

posts_quote_check.name: posts_quote_check
posts_quote_check.value: ("posts"."is_quote" OR "posts"."quoted_post_id" IS NULL) AND (NOT "posts"."is_quote" OR "posts"."parent_id" IS NULL)

posts_content_check.name: posts_content_check
posts_content_check.value: char_length("posts"."content") <= 2000 AND ("posts"."content" ~ '[^[:space:]]' OR ("posts"."content" = '' AND ("posts"."gif" IS NOT NULL OR "posts"."poll" IS NOT NULL OR "posts"."voice" IS NOT NULL)))
